subject.title: [Feature]: Inline agent widgets in web chat via client-capability-gated tools

question: Should OpenClaw accept a generic client-capability-gated tool availability contract plus a Canvas-owned inline `show_widget` tool for web chat, or keep widget rendering plugin-only until a narrower missing SDK/API seam is proven?
rationale: The request is not a narrow bug fix: it creates plugin/tool API surface and model-authored markup rendering policy, both of which require maintainer product and security-boundary intent.

options.title: Review the linked capability PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101840 as the candidate implementation and require sandbox/CSP/API review before merge.

options.title: Prototype outside core first
options.body: Ask for a ClawHub or local plugin prototype that proves the exact missing SDK/API contract before adding core capability-gating surface.

options.title: Defer rich inline widgets
options.body: Leave the issue open but unscheduled until web chat embed security and native-client adoption goals are clearer.

recommendation.title: Review the linked capability PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101840 as the candidate implementation and require sandbox/CSP/API review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current-main ownership trail is the merged Control UI rich-rendering/embed foundation that this request builds on.
